verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਧੀਰਜ ਧਰਮੁ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ਮੂੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau dharatee dheeraj dharam masakeenee mooRee|

en.bdb: As the earth is embodiment of continence, dharma and humility,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੀਂ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਤਿਸ ਮਣੀ ਨ ਕੂੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabh dhoo(n) neevee(n) hoi rahee tis manee na kooRee|

en.bdb: It remains under the feet and this humility is true and not false.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਰੂੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: koiee har ma(n)dhar karai ko karai arooRee|

en.bdb: Somebody constructs temple of god on it and some gather rubbish heaps on it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਫਲ ਅੰਬ ਲਸੂੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: jehaa beejai so lunai fal a(n)b lasooRee|

en.bdb: Whatever is sowed is got accordingly whether is be a mango or lasuri, a glutinous fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆਂ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਜੁੜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੂੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: jeevadhiaa(n) mar jeevanaa juR gurmukh jooRee|

en.bdb: While being dead in life i.e. deleting ego from the self, the gurmukhs  join gurmukhs in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਤਾਂ ਹੇਠਿ ਲਤਾੜੀਐ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਧਾਂ ਧੂੜੀ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: lataa(n) heTh lataaReeaai gat saadhaa(n) dhooRee ||19||

en.bdb: They become the dust of the feet of the holy men, which is trampled under the feet.
